## <a:Eyedropper:1526293991166054541> **Utility Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/colors`
View the colors extracted from your Discord profile and pick which one accents your panels
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `[page]` Open on Avatar, Banner, Username, Nameplate, or Deco
-# 🔹 `[source]` Your main profile, or your profile for this server
### `/timestamp`
Convert almost any date or time — including natural language — into a Discord timestamp that displays correctly in everyone's own timezone
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `<datetime>` e.g. "tomorrow", "in 2 hours", "dec 25 at 9am", "8pm to 10pm", "19:30"
-# 🔹 `[timezone]` Defaults to your saved `/settings` timezone
-# 🔹 `[style]` Short List, All Formats, or one format; blank uses your saved style
-# 🔹 `[view]` Embed or plain Text, one-off only
### `/invite`
Get a link to add Dioreo to a server or your own account, or a plain URL to share outside Discord

-# **Every command above also takes**
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

### Right-click (Apps)
**View Colors** on a member or one of their messages: their profile colors
**Convert Times** on a message: every date and time in it, as a timestamp in your own time zone

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/colors** page:`Nameplate` source:`From Server Profile`
-# 🔸 **/timestamp** datetime:`this saturday 7pm` timezone:`Pacific Time`
-# 🔸 **/timestamp** datetime:`august 20` style:`Short Date (d)`
-# 🔸 **/timestamp** datetime:`in 45 minutes` view:`Text`

## <a:ServerSettings:1536468904996774008> **Preference Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/settings`
Your own preferences: **Visibility** (who sees your responses by default), **Preferences** (timezone, timestamp style, accent style, and more), and your **Colors**

### `/admin`
Where Dioreo answers **publicly** and where it stays **private**, for the whole server. Needs **Manage Server**.
-# Opens a four-page panel — **Overview · Channels · Roles · Commands**

-# **Rule order** · the most specific one wins
-# 🔹 Command **→** Role **→** Channel **→** the Overview default
-# 🔹 Threads follow their parent channel · if two roles disagree, **public wins**

-# **Setting it up**
-# 🔸 Pick a default on **Overview**, then hand-pick the few channels or roles that should differ
-# 🔸 Rules only make Dioreo **quieter** — Public *permits* a public answer, it never overrides someone's own `/settings`

-# **Worth knowing**
-# 🔸 Each menu holds up to **25 picks** (Discord's limit). Needing more usually means a different default would suit better
-# 🔸 It hides the **answer**, not the command — to remove a command entirely, use **Server Settings → Integrations**

-# **Options** · `[open]` is /settings only; both take `[visibility]`
-# 🔹 `[open]` Open straight on Visibility, Preferences, or your Colors
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/settings** visibility:`Public`
-# 🔸 **/settings** open:`Colors`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Overview** → Default *Private*, then **Channels** → allow `#bot-spam`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Roles** → *Always public for these roles* → `@Moderator`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Commands** → `/colors` → *Private*: only `/colors` answers privately
-# Browse by category, or jump to one command

## <a:ServerSettings:1536468904996774008> **Preference Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/settings`
Your own preferences: **Visibility** (who sees your responses by default), **Preferences** (timezone, timestamp style, accent style, and more), and your **Colors**

### `/admin`
Where Dioreo answers **publicly** and where it stays **private**, for the whole server. Needs **Manage Server**.
-# Opens a four-page panel — **Overview · Channels · Roles · Commands**

-# **Rule order** · the most specific one wins
-# 🔹 Command **→** Role **→** Channel **→** the Overview default
-# 🔹 Threads follow their parent channel · if two roles disagree, **public wins**

-# **Setting it up**
-# 🔸 Pick a default on **Overview**, then hand-pick the few channels or roles that should differ
-# 🔸 Rules only make Dioreo **quieter** — Public *permits* a public answer, it never overrides someone's own `/settings`

-# **Worth knowing**
-# 🔸 Each menu holds up to **25 picks** (Discord's limit). Needing more usually means a different default would suit better
-# 🔸 It hides the **answer**, not the command — to remove a command entirely, use **Server Settings → Integrations**

-# **Options** · `[open]` is /settings only; both take `[visibility]`
-# 🔹 `[open]` Open straight on Visibility, Preferences, or your Colors
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/settings** visibility:`Public`
-# 🔸 **/settings** open:`Colors`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Overview** → Default *Private*, then **Channels** → allow `#bot-spam`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Roles** → *Always public for these roles* → `@Moderator`
-# 🔸 **/admin** → **Commands** → `/colors` → *Private*: only `/colors` answers privately
-# Browse by category, or jump to one command

## <a:BotAccess:1540915865506160660> **Bot Admin Commands**
-# **Usage: `/cmd <required> [optional]`**

### `/bot analytics`
The bot's usage, timing and health, without opening the server it runs on
-# 🔹 `[page]` Jump directly to a page: `Health` · `Alerts` · `Changes` · `Usage` · `Timing`
### `/bot access`
Who has admin access, and to what — owner-only
-# 🔹 No options of its own
### `/bot servers`
View, reset or delete one server's /admin rules, for an admin who lost access — owner-only
-# 🔹 `[server]` A server ID; leave it blank to pick the server you're in or type one
### `/bot hotpatch`
Reload changed files into the running bot without a restart — owner-only
-# 🔹 `[pull]` git pull first (default: yes)
-# 🔹 `[dry_run]` Show the plan and change nothing
-# 🔹 `[file]` Limit to one changed file (default: everything the pull brought in)
### `/emojis`
Every app emoji, which bots lack it and whether its original is saved: sync, upload or find one — owner-only
-# 🔹 No options of its own
### `/autobuild`
Read an MP or DMZ loadout out of a Gunsmith screenshot and stage it for review — nothing is saved until you press Save
-# 🔹 Run it on its own for a form that reads up to 10 screenshots and links at once, each with its own mode, category and badges
-# 🔹 `[screenshot]` The Gunsmith screenshot to read — or use `url` instead, never both
-# 🔹 `[url]` A link to the screenshot, when the image is already hosted somewhere
-# 🔹 `[category]` `AR` · `SMG` · `LMG` · `Marksman` · `Sniper` · `Shotgun` · `Secondary` — looked up from the weapon, or asked for, if left blank
-# 🔹 `[mode]` `MP` · `DMZ` — read from the screenshot if left blank, and asked for when the screenshot can't tell
-# 🔹 `[badges]` e.g. `meta,top5`: any of meta, toxic, ass, best, top3, top5, capable and the rank modes — this build only; blank means none
-# 🔹 `[retry_token]` Only for re-submitting an image after a Cloudinary upload failure
### `/manage`
The data-entry panel — seasonal info, draws, calendar, patch notes, loadouts, banners, announcements, and the next-season draft
-# 🔹 `[content]` Open a section directly: `Draws` · `Calendar` · `Patch Notes` · `MP Loadouts` · `DMZ Loadouts` · `Season: Titles & Deadlines` · `Season: Next Season Draft` · `Announcement` · `Bulk Format Guide`
-# 🔹 `[action]` Jump straight to one of that section's own actions (pick `content` first)
### Right-click (Apps)
**Add to Calendar** · **Add to Draws** · **Add to Patch Notes** on a message: stage its text into that /manage page
**Autobuild Gunsmith** on a message with a Gunsmith screenshot: the same review as /autobuild

-# **Options** · every command above except /bot hotpatch, /bot servers and /emojis
-# 🔹 `[visibility]` Show this response only to you, or publicly to everyone in the chat.

-# **Examples**
-# 🔸 **/bot analytics** page:`Usage` visibility:`Public` — share usage data in a channel
-# 🔸 **/autobuild** screenshot:`[upload]` category:`SMG` badges:`meta,top5`
-# 🔸 **/autobuild** url:`https://…` — when the screenshot is already hosted
-# 🔸 **/manage** content:`Patch Notes` — straight to the section, no clicking through
-# 🔸 **/manage** content:`Season: Next Season Draft` — stage next season without touching what is live

-# These are gated on **Dioreo's own admin allowlist** (four are owner-only), not on a server permission — Manage Server does not grant them, and they are not registered for guild install at all.
-# Browse by category, or jump to one command

-# 🔹 `[source]` Your main profile, or your profile for this server
### `/timestamp`
Convert almost any date or time — including natural language — into a Discord timestamp that displays correctly in everyone's own timezone
-# **Options**
-# 🔹 `<datetime>` e.g. "tomorrow", "in 2 hours", "dec 25 at 9am", "8pm to 10pm", "19:30"
-# 🔹 `[timezone]` Defaults to your saved `/settings` timezone
-# 🔹 `[style]` Short List, All Formats, or one format; blank uses your saved style
-# 🔹 `[view]` Embed or plain Text, one-off only
